movers.text: QB Ty Dieffenbach was carted off in OT of the Nov. 21 loss to Michigan (left leg); X-rays were reportedly negative and his USC status is uncertain. Nico Iamaleava is out for the season.
QB Julian Sayin (throwing arm) has missed every game since Oct. 17 with freshman Luke Fahey starting; Rotowire estimates a Nov. 28 return. Ohio State has not confirmed it.
QB Steve Angeli left the BC loss with a throwing-shoulder injury, arm in a sling; no update for Notre Dame. Malachi Nelson finished but re-aggravated his ankle.
Jeff Lebby said Nov. 22 the Egg Bowl starter depends on how injured QB AJ Swann practices this week; Billy Puckett started the Tennessee Tech win.
Dabo Swinney said backup QB Christopher Vizzina (concussion) 'definitely will not be back' for South Carolina; third-stringer Trent Pearman is in line to start again.

Syracuse.text: QB Steve Angeli left the BC loss with a throwing-shoulder injury, arm in a sling; no update for Notre Dame. Malachi Nelson finished but re-aggravated his ankle.

Mississippi State.text: Jeff Lebby said Nov. 22 the Egg Bowl starter depends on how injured QB AJ Swann practices this week; Billy Puckett started the Tennessee Tech win.

Clemson.text: Dabo Swinney said backup QB Christopher Vizzina (concussion) 'definitely will not be back' for South Carolina; third-stringer Trent Pearman is in line to start again.
Swinney expects LB Jeremiah Alexander back for South Carolina after missing Duke and hopes WR Tyler Brown and CB Elliot Washington II return; DT Champ Thompson is out for the season.

Houston.text: QB Conner Weigman (shoulder) missed the West Virginia win and will work to return for Baylor; freshman Keisean Henderson made his first start.

North Carolina.text: QB Billy Edwards Jr. (upper body) did not start the 41-24 loss at Virginia; freshman Travis Burgess made his first start. No status yet for NC State.

Alabama.text: QB Keelon Russell (ankle) sat out the Chattanooga win with Austin Mack starting; Kalen DeBoer expects him 'full speed, full go' in practice this week for Auburn.

Indiana.text: Indiana C Bray Lynch (lower leg) and WR Nick Marsh (late hit) were hurt in the OT loss at Washington; G Joe Brunner is out for the year. Cignetti gave no update.

South Carolina.text: QB LaNorris Sellers (ankle) returned vs Georgia on Nov. 21 after sitting vs Arkansas; 87 passing yards, 1 INT, sacked 3 times in a 34-6 loss.

Vanderbilt.text: QB Jared Curtis re-aggravated an old wrist injury late in the Florida loss and returned; Clark Lea does not expect a long-term issue and expects him to practice this week.

Florida State.text: Florida State's top four RBs were all out for the 28-10 loss to NC State on Nov. 21; No. 5 back Zay Parks started.

NC State.text: RB Duke Scott was hurt again in NC State's 28-10 win at Florida State on Nov. 21; Davion Gause replaced him. No status yet for the North Carolina game.

Georgia.text: Starting C Drew Bobo was ruled out on the SEC's final report for South Carolina, his second straight missed game; sophomore Cortez Smith started in his place.

Ole Miss.text: RB Kewan Lacy is done for the season and freshman RB Shekai Mills-Knight has a high ankle sprain, per Pete Golding (Nov. 17).
